facts.value: The Transfer Achievement Grant combines all federal grants and institutional aid up to the eligible amount, depending on your Student Aid Index from the FAFSA. Pell Grants, university grants and any institutional scholarships (such as RaiseMe, Earn to Learn, and the Phi Theta Kappa scholarship) are included in the Transfer Achievement Grant amount.
Eligible students must be admitted to ASU no later than the first day of classes for the term they applied for.
Students are encouraged to complete their steps to apply and FAFSA by Jan. 15 for fall and Oct. 1 for spring.
Financial aid packaging for admitted students typically begins in March for fall admits, and October for spring admits.
You can expect a financial aid package that includes the Transfer Achievement Grant approximately 4–6 weeks after completing your financial aid file.
Current ASU students are ineligible to be considered for the Transfer Achievement Grant.

value: Must be an Arizona resident for tuition purposes.
Must be a transfer student from an Arizona community college.
Must have a minimum 3.50 cumulative transfer GPA.
Must demonstrate financial need as determined by the FAFSA.
Must have submitted an ASU admission application, application fee and transcripts from each school attended by Jan. 15 for fall and Oct. 1 for spring.
Must have submitted a FAFSA for the appropriate academic year by Jan. 15 for fall and Oct. 1 for spring.

facts.value: The grant amount varies each year and is typically awarded in the fall semester. Spring amounts are dependent on the remaining funds from the previous fall.

For those awarded the Transfer Achievement Award in Spring 2026 or earlier, the award can be renewed for a total of four consecutive semesters (excluding summers) by completing 24 ASU credit hours with a 2.50 or higher ASU cumulative GPA and submitting a FAFSA by the above deadlines each year that demonstrates continued financial need.
Students may defer their admission if they have an approved admission deferment on file. Deferment requests must be submitted at least two weeks before the start of the admit term.
Students are not allowed to enroll at another postsecondary institution during their deferment period.
The Transfer Achievement Grant is available to any Arizona resident for tuition purposes who meets the eligibility criteria, regardless of whether the student enrolls on campus or online.
